name: TaxJar API
tagline: Sales tax calculation and reporting API for ecommerce platforms
description: TaxJar provides a REST API for real-time sales tax calculations, tax rate lookups, nexus management, and automated sales tax reporting. Used by ecommerce platforms and marketplaces to determine tax rates by location, calculate order tax, and file returns across US jurisdictions.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer header; obtain from TaxJar account dashboard after signup

use_cases: calculate sales tax for an ecommerce order by address
look up combined sales tax rate by ZIP code
list nexus regions for a merchant account
create a transaction for sales tax reporting
validate a customer address for tax purposes
